The more of me there is, the less you see. What am I?
I have hands but I cannot clap. What am I?
What goes up when the rain comes down?
You were chasing a golden butterfly when the jungle floor gave way. You fall through the roof of an old stone temple and land on the dusty floor of the Entrance Hall.
The hole above is far too high to climb. The only way out is through the temple, past its riddles, levers and tricky floors, and up the stairs to the sun.
Walk with the arrow keys, WASD, the buttons, or tap the map. Walk into things to use them. Nothing here can hurt you. If you slip, you only lose a little time.
You climb the worn stairs with the golden idol under your arm and push open a stone hatch. Sunlight pours over you. Birds sing. Far below, the temple gives a long, relieved rumble and goes quiet.

You leave the golden idol on its pedestal, because some treasure belongs where it is. The stairs end at a stone hatch. You push it open and the sunlight pours over you. Birds sing, and the golden butterfly is waiting.
The torch bracket is empty now.
You pull a torch from the wall bracket. It flares up with a warm orange light.
A cracked clay jar. Inside is a rolled note: "Light a torch before going deeper. The dark rooms hide the way."
The statue smiles. Its eyes glow green.
A faded mural shows three signs in a row: a Sun, then a Moon, then a Star. Under it: "Wake them in this order."
You lift the golden idol. The whole temple gives a long, deep rumble. Take the stairs when you are ready.
The third lever clunks down. Somewhere in the wall, a chain rattles and the north door grinds open.
Click-click-click. All the levers spring back up. Try again, the mural has the order.
It is pitch black beyond the door. You need a light first.
The door is sealed. Three statues guard it. Answer all of their riddles.
The stone door will not move. There must be a way to wake it.
Click! The tile sinks and you slide back to the start of the room.
You dust yourself off. Find a light, then find the way out.
Correct! The statue's eyes glow green.
A deep click echoes from the north door. It is open.
The statue's eyes flicker. That is not it. Try again, there is no rush.
